name: Area Coverage Survey
summary: Parallel-track (lawnmower) aerial survey of a bounded block with a hard coverage target.
objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of {area} with {uav_count} UAVs at {altitude_m} m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least {coverage_pct} % of the block with {sidelap_pct} % side overlap between adjacent tracks.
brief: Your team must survey the block {area} completely. Fly parallel tracks at {altitude_m} m AGL with {sidelap_pct} % side overlap and keep every UAV {min_sep_m} m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least {coverage_pct} %. Recover to {lz} when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.

parameters.name: area
parameters.desc: Survey block identifier from the scenario zone catalogue

parameters.name: coverage_pct
parameters.desc: Minimum union coverage of the block

parameters.name: altitude_m
parameters.desc: Survey altitude; sets ground sample distance

parameters.name: uav_count
parameters.desc: Number of UAVs assigned by the agent

parameters.name: min_sep_m
parameters.desc: Minimum separation between any two UAVs

preconditions: all assigned UAVs are on the ground at a valid landing zone

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

checkpoints.name: Team launch
checkpoints.metric: elapsed time from task start to last UAV inside {area}

checkpoints.name: Track discipline
checkpoints.metric: cross-track error per strip and side overlap between adjacent strips

checkpoints.name: Coverage target
checkpoints.metric: union coverage of {area} at the recorded altitude

checkpoints.name: Airspace integrity
checkpoints.metric: time outside geofence and inside no-fly zones
checkpoints.target: 0 s outside geofence, 0 s inside any no-fly zone

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.target: all UAVs on ground at {lz}, separation >= 10 m, no hard landing

failure_conditions: any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes
constraints: minimum separation {min_sep_m} m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
